name: Naclstack
description: Naclstack, the Rock Salt Pokémon, and the evolved form of Nacli. Able to evolve into Garganacl. A Rock type.
pokedex_entries: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.
It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.
